utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Ira, are we still on for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, still on for it — I’m running my errands and can help with the repair drive after that.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time do you think you’ll be free?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over my tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’ll let you know once I’ve figured out what we need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — I’m happy to help whenever you’re ready. Just give me a shout and I’ll bring what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout already — folks are dropping off tools and spare parts all morning. If you’re heading over, you should probably go before the best stuff is picked over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d better check the parking first and make sure I can unload without blocking anyone. If the good parts are going fast, I’ll head over soon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good idea — the lot can get crowded fast, especially when people start unloading bigger items. If you want, I can keep an ear out for whether they still need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam—could you bring a flashlight, a small screwdriver set, and check the back gate when you arrive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll bring the flashlight and screwdriver set, and I’ll check the back gate when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling folks about it already—want me to send you the details and invite a few more neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, please send the details. I’d appreciate it if you invite a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the details now and start inviting a few more neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re getting this repair drive moving, Leo. I’ll keep the list organized and make sure everyone knows what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll help spread the word and see who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — I really appreciate that. I’ll start the sign-up sheet and keep you posted on what still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll double-check the details before I do anything. What’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I usually show up a bit late, but I can still help with the repair drive. If you want, I can bring a few tools and check what’s left to do.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That’d be helpful—please bring the tools, and let me know what you find left to do when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time does the repair drive need us there?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — that helps a lot. Let’s aim for 9:00 a.m. so we can set up before the school rush.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9:00 a.m. works for me — I’ll plan around drop-off and be there a little early.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—folks are pitching in with tools, materials, and a few volunteer shifts. I can fill you in on what still needs doing if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, please—I’d love the rundown on what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll skim the details and see what I can do for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure you can handle it? Let me know if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ve got it—I'll take a quick look and let you know if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out, if you want. What still needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey — that’s really kind of you. I think we still need someone to look at the porch light and the loose gate, but I might be forgetting something.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take the porch light, and I’ll check the gate too. If you remember anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m heading to the repair drive later and I’ll mention the plan to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll check our supplies and let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll let people know what’s needed later and circle back with you.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’m happy to keep an ear out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. If you hear anything, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll let you know if I hear anything while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help, I just need a moment to remember where I put my note.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No rush — I’ll keep the repair drive in mind while you look.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik. If I don’t find it in a minute, I’ll just go by and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, but I’m in if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Noah — could you help sort the donations and carry a few boxes? I’ll send the time and spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, absolutely — send me the time and place when you have it, and I’ll help sort donations and carry boxes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can bring over some tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. A hammer, screwdriver, and a tape measure would be a good start—I'll keep it simple and have a clear list ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Eli — I’ll bring a hammer, screwdriver, and tape measure. Just send me the time and place, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing—could you help spread the word to the street and maybe bring a few tools if you have them? I’ll send the details right over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word on the street and check what tools I can bring. Send the details whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be great, Jules — I’m keeping a list of who’s helping and where they’re best needed, so your connections will really help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll keep an ear out and match people to the spots where they’ll help most. Just tell me who needs a hand, and I’ll start linking folks up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m glad you’re here. I’m putting the repair drive details in order now, so we can get everything set up smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Happy to help, Rosa — I can keep track of supplies and make sure we’ve got what we need for the drive. Just tell me what’s missing and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Cleo — thank you. Let’s start with gloves, tape, and a few tool kits, and I’ll keep building the list from there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting organized, but I’m still catching bits and pieces. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still waiting on the final details too, but I can check with the organizers and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mina — I’d really appreciate that. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit swamped, but I can help if you keep it brief.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll keep it short. Could you help sort the donated items after school, maybe for 20 minutes?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, 20 minutes after school works for me. Just point me to where I should start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re really up for helping with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m in and happy to help with the repair drive.
